name: visual-test
description: Backstop visual regression. Default backstop.json compares Azure SWA (url) against monroe-humane.org WordPress (referenceUrl) — NOT SWA-vs-SWA. Do not point both url and referenceUrl at the same live SWA host (false-green trap).

scripts.test: node -e "console.error('visual-test: disabled as a default CI gate (Phase 0). Use backstop reference/test intentionally after confirming url != referenceUrl.'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.backstop:check-config: node -e "const c=require('./backstop.json'); for (const s of c.scenarios||[]) { const u=(s.url||'').replace(/\/$/,''); const r=(s.referenceUrl||'').replace(/\/$/,''); if (u && r && u===r) { console.error('CIRCULAR visual-test scenario:', s.label); process.exit(1);} } console.log('ok: no circular scenarios');"
